claims.statement: Cartoon of the Virgin and St Anne known from descriptions, among them the Novellara letter. The relation to the later compositions is an interpretation.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Novellara letter; Vasari.
